products.name: LMSYS Arena Models
products.note: Model evaluation platform; crowdsourced benchmarking; research transparency; no production use

profile_text.body:
LMSYS operates lmarena.ai, a community-driven platform for evaluating and ranking large language models. The site describes itself as an official AI ranking and LLM leaderboard where users can chat with, compare, and vote on AI models across text, image, and code tasks. Conversations submitted by users may be shared with AI providers and made publicly available to support research, and the platform also uses those conversations for automated evaluation by sending prompts to providers at a later time for scoring and comparison.

The organization's tracked product, LMSYS Arena Models, is categorized as a model evaluation platform built around crowdsourced benchmarking and research transparency, with no production use. LMSYS is verified as a nonprofit organization. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP registry entries are recorded in the held facts.
